name: stockfolio
description: A full-stack, real-time stock portfolio tracker — rebuilt from an academic Flask/MySQL mini-project into a modern, production-shaped app: React + TypeScript frontend, Node/Express + TypeScript API, live price streaming over WebSockets, and real market data (NSE, BSE and US tickers) with no paid API key required.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
